sapFields: KUNNR, NAME1, LAND1, ORT01, KTOKD, LOEVM, ERDAT
countSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM SAP_LANDING.KNA1
mergeSql: MERGE INTO SAP_CORE.KNA1 T USING (SELECT * FROM SAP_LANDING.KNA1 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY KUNNR ORDER BY KUNNR) = 1) S ON T.KUNNR = S.KUNNR WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.NAME1 = S.NAME1, T.LAND1 = S.LAND1, T.ORT01 = S.ORT01, T.KTOKD = S.KTOKD, T.LOEVM = S.LOEVM, T.ERDAT = TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(S.ERDAT, '00000000'), 'YYYYMMDD'), T._LOADED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), T._ADF_RUN_ID = '{runId}' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (KUNNR, NAME1, LAND1, ORT01, KTOKD, LOEVM, ERDAT, _LOADED_AT, _ADF_RUN_ID) VALUES (S.KUNNR, S.NAME1, S.LAND1, S.ORT01, S.KTOKD, S.LOEVM, TRY_TO_DATE(NULLIF(S.ERDAT, '00000000'), 'YYYYMMDD'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), '{runId}')
